I read in one of ur fatwas dat we have 2 keep a distance of 4 fingers betwen our feet in salaat while in behist zewar is writtn dat the ankles shud meet. Also u wrote dat there were 124000 msngrs sent bt in FURU UL IMAAN by maulana ashraf ali thanvi is writn dat we shud nt fix d number of prophets. N do girlz have 2 say jazakillah or jazakAllah 2 each other. Question: Assalamoalaikum. I read in one of ur fatwas dat we have 2 keep a distance of 4 fingers betwen our feet in salaat while in behist zewar is writtn dat the ankles shud meet. Also u wrote dat there were 124000 msngrs sent bt in FURU UL IMAAN by maulana ashraf ali thanvi is writn dat we shud nt fix d number of prophets. N do girlz have 2 say jazakillah or jazakAllah 2 each other. Answer ID: 12813 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1147/885=H/1430) (1) Write the complete text of Bahishti Zewar. (2) There is no need to fix a number, in some books it is mentioned to be 1,24,000 but it is also not fixed. (3) One should say Jazakillah, it is so required by the grammar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
